entries.label: Metal Gear REX — The Twin Snakes

generation.prompt: Create ONE isolated full-body 2D painted source asset of METAL GEAR REX specifically as modeled in METAL GEAR SOLID: THE TWIN SNAKES on Nintendo GameCube. All three reference screenshots are from The Twin Snakes and govern the model: preserve broad boxy flat angular dinosaur-like upper head/cockpit, bulky angular thighs, exposed black lower central machinery, very thick reverse-jointed legs and broad wedge-shaped armored feet with the long pointed toe spikes, compact circular lens/missile clusters below the broad head. Preserve asymmetric armament: large round radar dish on the machine's anatomical LEFT shoulder and long angular railgun mounted on its anatomical RIGHT shoulder. Show whole REX with its head/nose facing SCREEN RIGHT in an approximately side three-quarter view; camera on its left side, so round radome can be prominent on near shoulder and railgun visible on farther shoulder above body. Full radar disc, complete railgun, both feet and all toe tips within clear generous margins. TTS appearance is clean broad olive gray/pale gray camouflaged polygonal metal panels, darker mechanical joints, simple large plate geometry. Do not replace with the far more weathered detailed MGS4 REX or modern merchandise redesign; honor the specific GameCube screenshots even where their geometry is simple. Head intact first battle configuration, no liquid pilot exposed, no damage effects. Detailed 2D painted rendering of exact reference geometry, restrained texture detail and neutral light. No humans, hangar, floor, external shadows, text labels, UI, logo, frame or background. TRUE transparent RGBA including all gaps between legs and weapons.

notes: Aucun résultat image ni fichier reçu; ne doit pas être compté comme source générée. Les captures TTS sont identifiées; motif de catégorie other non précisé par le filtre.
